therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) / mitochondrial complex I
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: AMPK activation / mitochondrial complex I inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: hepatic glucose output reduction and insulin sensitization
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants achieving HbA1c <7% during third trimester and at delivery

results.effect_size: Third trimester: 5/? metformin vs 12/? insulin achieved HbA1c <7%; At delivery: 5/? metformin vs 7/? insulin achieved HbA1c <7%
biomarker_changes: HbA1c <7% during third trimester: 5 participants in metformin arm vs 12 in insulin arm
HbA1c <7% at delivery: 5 participants in metformin arm vs 7 in insulin arm
safety_signals: No hypoglycemia events in either arm during pregnancy
1 case of shoulder dystocia in metformin arm vs 0 in insulin arm
1 case of respiratory distress syndrome in metformin arm vs 3 in insulin arm
0 neonates needing dextrose in metformin arm vs 1 in insulin arm

dose_info.dose: 500 mg (metformin); weight/gestational-age-based dosing (insulin NPH and Regular)
dose_info.schedule: Metformin: once daily titrated up to 2500 mg/day; Insulin: subcutaneously 3 times a day
dose_info.dose_modifications: Metformin increased as needed to maintain glycemic control; insulin dose adjusted based on maternal gestational age and weight

context.duration: Duration of pregnancy (approximately September 2008 to August 2011)
